2607.01303.title: CPG-PAD: Concept-Informed Prompts Guided Presentation Attack Detection
2607.01303.paper_summary: Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) serves as a crucial safeguard for face recognition systems against presentation attacks such as printed photos, replayed videos, and 3D masks. Despite significant progress, existing PAD models still struggle to generalize across unseen domains due to variations in sensors, lighting, and attack materials. Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong generalization ability, yet their applications in PAD remain limited because learned prompts, typically optimized under class-label supervision, fail to explicitly align with fine-grained attack-relevant visual semantics. As a result, the learned representations often overfit domain-specific artifacts instead of capturing transferable attack cues. To address this, we propose Concept-Informed Prompts Guided Presentation Attack Detection (CPG-PAD), a framework that introduces model-level concept guidance into the prompt learning process. Specifically, we design a Visual Concept-driven Enhancement (VCE) module that employs eXplainable AI (XAI) techniques to automatically discover PAD-relevant visual concepts and generate concept-associated heatmaps providing localized fine-grained guidance. Guided by these heatmaps, a Prompt-based Concept Injection (PCI) mechanism integrates these concepts into the prompt space through a Visual-Prompt Decoder (VPD) and a concept-mapping loss, enabling prompts to align with the model's internal concept space. This design enables CPG-PAD to capture generalizable and domain-invariant attack cues while effectively suppressing dataset-specific biases. Extensive experiments across nine benchmark datasets demonstrate that CPG-PAD consistently achieves state-of-the-art cross-domain performance under multi-source, limited-source, and single-source settings.
2607.01303.paper_summary_zh: Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) 作為面部識別系統對抗展示攻擊（如印刷照片、重播視頻和3D面具）的重要保障。<lb/>儘管取得了顯著進展，但現有的 PAD 模型仍然難以在未見過的領域中進行泛化，這是由於傳感器、照明和攻擊材料的變化。<lb/>最近的視覺-語言模型（VLMs）顯示出強大的泛化能力，然而它們在 PAD 中的應用仍然有限，因為學習到的提示通常是在類別標籤監督下優化的，未能明確對齊與細粒度攻擊相關的視覺語義。<lb/>因此，學習到的表示往往過度擬合於特定領域的工件，而不是捕捉可轉移的攻擊線索。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了概念引導的提示引導展示攻擊檢測（CPG-PAD），這是一個將模型級概念指導引入提示學習過程的框架。<lb/>具體而言，我們設計了一個視覺概念驅動的增強（VCE）模塊，該模塊利用可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）技術自動發現與 PAD 相關的視覺概念並生成與概念相關的熱圖，提供局部的細粒度指導。<lb/>在這些熱圖的指導下，基於提示的概念注入（PCI）機制通過視覺提示解碼器（VPD）和概念映射損失將這些概念整合到提示空間中，使提示與模型的內部概念空間對齊。<lb/>這一設計使得 CPG-PAD 能夠捕捉可泛化和領域不變的攻擊線索，同時有效抑制數據集特定的偏差。<lb/>在九個基準數據集上進行的廣泛實驗表明，CPG-PAD 在多源、有限源和單源設置下始終實現了最先進的跨域性能。
